claims.claim_ar: تشبيه: مقارنة بين عيسى وآدم باستخدام أداة التشبيه (كَمَثَل) لإظهار أنهما بشر
claims.claim_en: Simile: the comparison of Jesus and Adam using the simile marker (kamathal) to show they are both human
claims.rhetorical_effect: Undermines claims of unique divinity by equating Jesus with Adam, emphasizing shared humanity and thereby promoting theological parity.

warnings: Provided source chunks are all from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari). The developer-specified commentators (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha) are not present in the supplied chunks; the claim above is supported by a substring found in the provided chunk(s).

Only a single ayah-level device (simile/tashbih) was extracted because the supplied chunks contained an explicit matching substring ('بشر مثلنا'). Other possible devices in the ayah (e.g., ijaz, fasl-wasl, iltifat) were not corroborated by the provided source chunks and thus were not claimed.
